collection.title: VW Transporter T4 1990 to 2003 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Transporter T4 1990 to 2003 model requires a 21" wiper blade for the drivers and a 20" for the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also have rear blades for the Transporter T4, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
